total_prompts.description: Total posted prompts observed across fetched history

avg_per_day.description: Average prompts per day across observed span

database.instructions: prompt_leaderboard_v1 stores aggregated prompting stats keyed by user_id. Join against public.user to resolve usernames and avatars for display. Example: select pl.*, u.username from public.prompt_leaderboard_v1 pl join public.user u on (u.id = pl.id) order by pl.total_prompts desc
